Dr. Morgan treats knee and shoulder injuries in athletes of every level, from weekend runners to college teams. She uses minimally invasive surgery when surgery is needed, and starts with physical therapy and bracing whenever she can. Her clinical interests include ACL reconstruction, cartilage repair, and helping patients return to sports safely. Outside the clinic she coaches a youth soccer team.
